messages.subject: apply and plyr functions
parts:
Hi:
I am trying to use one of the plyr functions to estimate quantiles for
multiple variables in a dataset but can't get it right. For example:
apply(mtcars,2,quantile)
would return all quantiles(0,25,50,75,100) per each variable in the
dataframe but I only want
the 75% per each variable. Can this be done with one of the plyr
functions? ddply is what I would like to use
but I can't find the way to get only .75. Any help is appreciated.

messages.author: 294dd232bf4ab480
messages.subject: Re: apply and plyr functions
parts:
Hi Felpe -

It looks like just need to add in the 0.75 quantile at the end of your apply() statement. 

apply(mtcars,2,quantile, 0.75)

> apply(mtcars, 2, quantile)
        mpg cyl    disp    hp  drat      wt    qsec vs am gear carb
0%   10.400   4  71.100  52.0 2.760 1.51300 14.5000  0  0    3    1
25%  15.425   4 120.825  96.5 3.080 2.58125 16.8925  0  0    3    2
50%  19.200   6 196.300 123.0 3.695 3.32500 17.7100  0  0    4    2
75%  22.800   8 326.000 180.0 3.920 3.61000 18.9000  1  1    4    4
100% 33.900   8 472.000 335.0 4.930 5.42400 22.9000  1  1    5    8

> apply(mtcars, 2, quantile, 0.75)
   mpg    cyl   disp     hp   drat     wt   qsec     vs     am   gear   carb 
 22.80   8.00 326.00 180.00   3.92   3.61  18.90   1.00   1.00   4.00   4.00 e)


- Patrick
